evidence: The rail trail is a gently graded 18 km walk or mountain bike ride.
The section from Kaitoke to Cross Creek Station is wide and well maintained.
Cross Creek Station to Cross Creek Road end is an easy walking track but is elevated to an Intermediate: Grade 3 mountain biking track due to some steep drop offs.
A bike ride from Kaitoke to the Summit takes about an hour.

doubts: Kaitoke is named in the text but has no name or feature entry, so the start has no ref. The end is the Cross Creek Road end, matched to the road end feature F1 where the Remutaka Rail Trail meets Cross Creek Road. The Summit (T7) is taken as the trail's summit named in the text. Siberia Tunnels are placed between the Summit and Cross Creek from the viewing platform sentence, which is an inference. Ladle Bend is described as lying below the Rail Trail, so it is not_on_route rather than a via. The Pakuratahi Forest access (from Upper Hutt) has no stated road end or onto, and it is not known whether it is the Kaitoke start. The time and distance are DOC's.
